nonrepeating.title: Localised date macro
nonrepeating.description: Display times in each viewer’s time zone

repeating.title: Repeating localised date macro
repeating.description: Display recurring times in viewers’ time zones

time.label: Time
time.description: The time, in the timezone selected below, in the format hh:mm am/pm

date.label: Date
date.description: The date, in the timezone selected below.

startDate.label: Start Date
startDate.description: The start date, in the timezone selected below.

timeZone.label: Timezone
timeZone.description: The timezone that the Date Time above is configured for. If you have written the above in your local time then select your local timezone.

repetitionUnit.label: Repetition Unit
repetitionUnit.description: What unit of time to use for the repetitions.

repetitionPeriod.label: Period
repetitionPeriod.description: The number of units (weeks, days etc) before this event repeats. Must be 1 or higher.

displayOption.label: Display format
displayOption.description: How your date will be displayed to the viewer.

clock.label: Clock
clock.description: Automatic follows each viewer’s language. 12-hour and 24-hour apply to viewers whose language is English. Other languages keep their usual clock.

notConfigured.macro: Macro not configured. Please configure it in the Macro Configuration.
notConfigured.date: Date not configured. Please configure it in the Macro Configuration.
notConfigured.time: Time not configured. Please configure it in the Macro Configuration.
notConfigured.timeZone: Time Zone not configured. Please configure it in the Macro Configuration.
notConfigured.repetitionPeriod: Repetition period not configured. Please configure it in the Macro Configuration.
notConfigured.field: {field} not configured. Please configure it in the Macro Configuration.

error.repetitionPeriodInvalid: Repetition period must be a whole number of 1 or higher.
error.repetitionPeriodInvalidWithHint: Repetition period must be a whole number of 1 or higher. Please configure it in the Macro Configuration.
error.invalidTime: Time "{time}" not in the "XX:XX (am|pm)" format! Example, valid values are: "9:00 am" or "12:45 pm".

tooltip.colocated: Co-located: You are viewing this date-time from the same timezone it was configured for.
